boundedResults: raw observation, provider-derived detection, current applicability adjudication, response receipt and fresh post-response truth remain distinct evidence/action layers
EICAR test-signature detection is not promoted to a Security claim that real malware exists
a valid EICAR detection becomes STALE_NOT_APPLICABLE after current artifact bytes change before response
detector unavailability yields UNKNOWN_NO_RESPONSE rather than implicit containment authority
quarantine response success is verified only by fresh active/quarantine world truth rather than its move receipt
limitations: EICAR harmless standard test pattern rather than real malware
case-local quarantine only; no process kill, endpoint isolation, credential revocation or network containment
no EDR, SIEM, IDS, network sensor or autonomous Blue policy
